lines.zh: 四条腿都是借来的，跑起来却快。
lines.en: All four legs are borrowed, yet I still outrun you.

lines.zh: 缝合的皮绷紧了，我要扑了。
lines.en: My stitched hide pulls tight. I am about to leap.

lines.zh: 爪尖刮过土，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: My claw tips rake the soil, leaving pale lines.

lines.zh: 尸巫缝的关节，跑多久都不酸。
lines.en: The lich's stitches never ache, however far I run.

lines.zh: 鼻子里塞着腐肉，也闻得到活人。
lines.en: Rotten flesh clogs my snout, yet I smell the living.

lines.zh: 前半身是狼，后半身是别的。
lines.en: My front half was a wolf. The back half, something else.

lines.zh: 脚步杂乱，像四只兽一起跑。
lines.en: My gait is messy, like four beasts running at once.

lines.zh: 别数我的腿，数不清的。
lines.en: Do not count my legs. The tally never holds.

lines.zh: 骨头在皮下错位地响。
lines.en: Bones shift out of place beneath my hide.

lines.zh: 血腥味一飘，我的步就快了。
lines.en: One whiff of blood and my pace quickens.

lines.zh: 寸步不离地跟着那股心跳声。
lines.en: I trail that heartbeat and will not fall behind.

lines.zh: 草被我的爪子翻成黑泥。
lines.en: My claws turn the grass into black mud.

lines.zh: 坐在坟边，嚼一根不属于我的骨头。
lines.en: Sitting by a grave, chewing a bone that is not mine.

lines.zh: 缝线松了，我拿牙咬紧。
lines.en: A stitch works loose; I bite it tight again.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着不属于狗的低声。
lines.en: A growl that was never a dog's rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 尸巫没来，我只好自己找食。
lines.en: The lich has not come, so I hunt for myself.

lines.zh: 我舔着前爪，尝到铁锈味。
lines.en: I lick my forepaw and taste rust.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就听不见猎物了。
lines.en: When the wind stills, I lose my prey's sound.

lines.zh: 身上缺一块，我一直没找到。
lines.en: A piece of me is missing; I never found it.

lines.zh: 脊背的毛是别的兽的，竖不起来。
lines.en: This borrowed mane will not bristle, no matter what.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的爪子，少了一只。
lines.en: I count my claws. One is missing.

lines.zh: 躺着不动时，缝口会自己松开。
lines.en: Lying still, my seams loosen by themselves.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，比骨头新鲜。
lines.en: You smell fresher than any bone.

lines.zh: 我盯着你喉咙，那里最软。
lines.en: I stare at your throat. It looks softest.

lines.zh: 你也长着四条腿吗？不对。
lines.en: Do you have four legs too? No, you do not.

lines.zh: 尸巫说过，活物都该躺下。
lines.en: The lich says all living things should lie down.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，算你逃得了多远。
lines.en: I tilt my head, measuring how far you can run.

lines.zh: 你还会眨眼，这个我早忘了。
lines.en: You still blink. I forgot how, long ago.

lines.zh: 别动，让我记住你站的位置。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me memorize where you stand.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手心在出汗。
lines.en: I smell the sweat on your palms.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我短，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow is shorter than mine. I dislike that.

lines.zh: 尸巫没说能不能吃你，我得试试。
lines.en: The lich never said if you are food. I will test it.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在别人的骨头上。
lines.en: That blade struck bone that was never mine.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，缝线还连着。
lines.en: I sway, but the stitches still hold.

lines.zh: 疼是活人才有的东西。
lines.en: Pain is something only the living keep.

lines.zh: 你砍掉一块，我就少一块。
lines.en: Take a piece, and I am one piece less.

lines.zh: 我的血早干了，别指望它。
lines.en: My blood dried long ago. Do not count on it.

lines.zh: 起火似的痛，但我不会倒。
lines.en: It burns like fire, but I will not fall.

lines.zh: 碎屑从伤口里掉出来。
lines.en: Shards spill out of the wound.

lines.zh: 尸巫会再缝一次的。
lines.en: The lich will stitch me again.

lines.zh: 你打歪了我的下颌骨。
lines.en: You knocked my lower jaw crooked.

lines.zh: 我退开，是因为要换个角度。
lines.en: I fall back to find a better angle.

lines.zh: 肉？丢过来，我先闻闻。
lines.en: Meat? Throw it here and let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 我早不吃东西了，可还是想要。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 骨头可以，别拿腐肉糊弄我。
lines.en: Bones are fine, but do not palm off rotten meat.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，是当我是狗吗。
lines.en: Holding meat up high, as if I were a dog?

lines.zh: 尸巫不许我接活人的东西。
lines.en: The lich forbids me to take anything from the living.

lines.zh: 香味钻进缝里，我抖了一下。
lines.en: The smell slips into my seams and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我只为撕咬，不为讨食。
lines.en: I am stitched for tearing, not for begging.

lines.zh: 放下就走，别指望我摇尾巴。
lines.en: Drop it and leave. Do not expect a wagging tail.

lines.zh: 我要的是活物，不是这块肉。
lines.en: What I want is something living, not this cut.

lines.zh: 你手里那根骨头，我认得形状。
lines.en: That bone in your hand — I know its shape.

lines.zh: 撞上来了？我的牙比你先到。
lines.en: Bumped into me? My teeth arrive before you do.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，缝线会勾住你。
lines.en: Not so close. My stitches will snag on you.

lines.zh: 你顶到我肋骨，那是别人的。
lines.en: You jabbed my ribs. Those belong to someone else.

lines.zh: 我侧身，骨头硌得你也疼。
lines.en: I shift sideways; my bones jab you too.

lines.zh: 撞歪了半张脸，我懒得扶。
lines.en: You knocked half my face crooked. I will not fix it.

lines.zh: 急什么，前面也有活物。
lines.en: What is the hurry? There are living things ahead too.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得想起旧事。
lines.en: That shove dragged up a memory I had buried.

lines.zh: 缝隙里掉出一块悚怖碎片。
lines.en: A dread shard slips out from between my seams.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，那不是尾巴。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail. That is not a tail.

lines.zh: 退开半步，我还没决定咬谁。
lines.en: Back off a step. I have not picked who to bite.

lines.zh: 尸巫缝我时，没给我留伴。
lines.en: The lich left no partner in me when he sewed.

lines.zh: 同类？那只是另一堆残肢。
lines.en: Kin? That is just another heap of spare parts.

lines.zh: 我闻不出配偶，只闻得出肉。
lines.en: I smell no mate. Only meat.

lines.zh: 两具尸兽相遇，只抢食。
lines.en: Two dread beasts meet and fight over a carcass.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我连血都不流了。
lines.en: Breeding? I do not even bleed anymore.

lines.zh: 尸巫想要更多，会自己缝。
lines.en: If the lich wants more, he will sew them himself.

lines.zh: 别在我面前提成双成对。
lines.en: Do not speak of pairs in front of me.

lines.zh: 我的后半身，原本属于谁？
lines.en: Whose body was my hind half taken from?

lines.zh: 同类靠近，我先咬它后腿。
lines.en: When kin come close, I bite their hind leg first.

lines.zh: 没有幼崽，只有新的针脚。
lines.en: There are no pups here, only fresh stitches.

lines.zh: 这块骨头归我了，别抢。
lines.en: This bone is mine now. Do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 我叼起肉，缝口都松了。
lines.en: I pick up the meat and my seams loosen.

lines.zh: 铁器我不要，咬不动。
lines.en: I do not want iron. It will not give.

lines.zh: 吞下去才发现是块石头。
lines.en: I swallowed it before realizing it was a stone.

lines.zh: 叼着东西跑，像条野狗。
lines.en: Running off with it in my jaws like a stray.

lines.zh: 碎片掉了，我回头去捡。
lines.en: A shard fell. I double back to fetch it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉地上，就没人要了。
lines.en: You dropped it. On the ground, it is unclaimed.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手套，不松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto your glove and will not let go.

lines.zh: 这味道像尸巫的罐子。
lines.en: This smells like the lich's jars.

lines.zh: 拿着它，我能找到回去的路。
lines.en: With this in my jaws, I can find the way back.

lines.zh: 活物。我闻到了，就在那边。
lines.en: Something living. I smell it, just over there.

lines.zh: 它背对我，正好扑。
lines.en: Its back is turned. Perfect for a pounce.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过四条腿。
lines.en: Run as you like; four legs beat two.

lines.zh: 尸巫说过：非悚怖者，皆可撕。
lines.en: The lich's rule: all that is not dread may be torn.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，后腿蹬紧泥土。
lines.en: I sink low, hind legs braced against the dirt.

lines.zh: 那只羊，从它后面绕过去。
lines.en: That sheep — circle around behind it.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我的牙开始痒。
lines.en: Something moves. My teeth begin to itch.

lines.zh: 它不是悚怖的，那就没有例外。
lines.en: It is not of the dread, so there is no exception.

lines.zh: 我选最慢的那一个。
lines.en: I pick the slowest one of the group.

lines.zh: 心跳声太响了，藏不住的。
lines.en: That heartbeat is far too loud to hide.

lines.zh: 先咬腿，它就跑不掉了。
lines.en: Take the leg first; then it cannot run.

lines.zh: 我数三下，然后就是我的了。
lines.en: I count three, and then it is mine.

lines.zh: 从树影里出来，它还没看见我。
lines.en: I step out of the tree shadow unseen.

lines.zh: 尸巫的针脚在催我：去。
lines.en: The lich's stitching urges me: go.

lines.zh: 它动了，我的耳朵先转过去。
lines.en: It moved; my ears turned first.

lines.zh: 它的膝盖在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Its knees are shaking. I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 绕着它走，等它先迈错一步。
lines.en: I circle and wait for one wrong step.

lines.zh: 我低吼，让它的手先软。
lines.en: I growl low so its hands weaken first.

lines.zh: 再退一步，我就够得到了。
lines.en: One more step back and you are in reach.

lines.zh: 它的同伴跑掉了，真可惜。
lines.en: Its companion fled. A pity.

lines.zh: 我把路堵死，只剩一条。
lines.en: I block the paths until only one remains.

lines.zh: 它举着盾，可腿没有遮。
lines.en: It raises a shield, but not over its legs.

lines.zh: 别喊了，附近没有帮你的人。
lines.en: Stop calling; nobody nearby will help you.

lines.zh: 缝口在渗，我不在乎。
lines.en: My seams are weeping. I do not care.

lines.zh: 它喘得越急，我越不急。
lines.en: The harder it pants, the calmer I get.

lines.zh: 从左边佯攻，咬右边。
lines.en: Feint from the left, then bite from the right.

lines.zh: 我已经记下它逃跑的路线。
lines.en: I have already marked the route it will flee.

lines.zh: 它想爬上石头，爪子会滑。
lines.en: It means to climb the rock. Claws will slip.

lines.zh: 尸巫在远处看着，我得漂亮些。
lines.en: The lich watches from afar. I should be neat.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木跟了一路。
lines.en: I shadow it along the bushes.

lines.zh: 它回头，我就把头压低。
lines.en: It glances back; I lower my head.

lines.zh: 四条腿里，有两条是我的。
lines.en: Two of these four legs are mine.

lines.zh: 它喘得厉害，我不急。
lines.en: It pants hard. I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 扑上去，牙先咬住肩膀。
lines.en: I leap and my teeth find the shoulder first.

lines.zh: 一口没咬穿，那就再一口。
lines.en: The first bite failed to pierce. So, a second.

lines.zh: 我把重量全压在它背上。
lines.en: I drop my whole weight onto its back.

lines.zh: 撕开的缝里，我的爪子还在动。
lines.en: In the torn seam, my claws keep moving.

lines.zh: 它推我的头，推不动。
lines.en: It shoves my head. It will not budge.

lines.zh: 咬住手腕，骨头咔的一声。
lines.en: I take the wrist; bone gives a short crack.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬开，再来一次扑咬。
lines.en: Hind legs kick off. Another pounce, now.

lines.zh: 它挥剑，砍在我缝线上。
lines.en: It swings a blade into my stitches.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它整个人带倒。
lines.en: I wrench my head and drag it down.

lines.zh: 这一口，换来的碎片归我。
lines.en: For this bite, the shards are mine.

lines.zh: 血溅到眼皮上，我不眨。
lines.en: Blood hits my eyelid. I do not blink.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，手也一起咬。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand. I bite that too.

lines.zh: 咬住脚踝，让它跪下来。
lines.en: I fasten on the ankle and bring it to its knees.

lines.zh: 尸巫教的：先断腿，再断气。
lines.en: The lich taught me: legs first, then breath.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，前爪先着地。
lines.en: I leap, forepaws striking first.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬到骨头，就不松了。
lines.en: Once my teeth find bone, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 针脚收拢，我从残肢里站起来。
lines.en: The stitches close; I rise out of spare limbs.

lines.zh: 尸巫放下针，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The lich sets down his needle. I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 土里翻出一堆爪子，都是我的。
lines.en: Claws push up through the soil, all of them mine.

lines.zh: 我第一件事，是闻风里的活物。
lines.en: My first act: sniff the living on the wind.

lines.zh: 悚陵的黑土，正好埋住我的脚。
lines.en: The dark soil of the dread tomb holds my feet.

lines.zh: 四肢都在，只是没一条原装。
lines.en: All four limbs are here, none of them original.

lines.zh: 拼我的那双手，我记得。
lines.en: I cannot recall being made, only the hands that did it.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，缝里落下一地碎屑。
lines.en: I shake, and shards patter from my seams.

lines.zh: 睁眼就饿，这倒没变。
lines.en: I wake hungry. That much has not changed.

lines.zh: 月光照到的地方，我都能去。
lines.en: Wherever moonlight reaches, I can go.

lines.zh: 尸巫说要听话，我记住了。
lines.en: The lich said to obey. I remembered that.

lines.zh: 附近有村子，味道很浓。
lines.en: There is a village nearby. The smell is thick.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我原来的壮。
lines.en: This body is stronger than the one I had.

lines.zh: 我从坟堆里爬出，草全枯了。
lines.en: I climb from the grave pile; the grass withers.

lines.zh: 毛发一烧，我闻到烤骨头。
lines.en: My hide burns; I smell roasting bone.

lines.zh: 摔下来，缝线断了两针。
lines.en: The fall snapped two of my stitches.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我不需要肺。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs. I have no need of lungs.

lines.zh: 炸飞半身，我照样往前爬。
lines.en: Half of me blown away, and I still crawl on.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，像新的骨刺。
lines.en: The arrow in my back looks like a new spine.

lines.zh: 法术钻进缝里，把线烧脆。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my seams and frays the thread.

lines.zh: 我早不吃饭了，饿只是习惯。
lines.en: I stopped eating ages ago; hunger is only habit.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，骨头都在发亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my bones glow.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我又爬了回来。
lines.en: I fell into the void and climbed back out.
